main_measure.name: mean of forecast/10 x (10-bar return - coin drift) over chop short cases

statistic.name: t of the mean, cases summed per day

main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2 (and both halves positive); reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2

supporting_check.name: min of mean short gain over drift in moderate and deep |forecast| halves (moderate -0.007464077229047727, deep 0.02325661003292701)

decided_by: The t of the main mean lies between -2 and 2.
reading: Chop is recomputed as the 60-day percent return from closes in [-10, +10] where 60 bars of the window exist, else taken from the recorded regime; the fall is fall30's raw value < 0; the drift is the coin's mean 10-bar return on the non-overlapping grid of all its windows; the t is the clustered t with deviations summed per UTC day; the halves are |forecast| below the median (moderate) and at or above it (deep).
